title: On Minimum CADs for Algebraic Sets in Dimension Three
summary: Cylindrical Algebraic Decomposition (CAD) algorithms typically produce a decomposition adapted to a finite family of semi-algebraic sets $\mathcal{F}$ (i.e. every member of $\mathcal{F}$ is a union of cells). Different algorithms may produce different outputs, and introduce unnecessary cell divisions. Recent work by Michel, Mathonet, and Zénaïdi in ISSAC 2024 formalised this issue by studying the refinement order on the set of all CADs adapted to $\mathcal{F}$ and analysing the existence of a minimum (coarsest) adapted CAD.
